text:
Which statement about boiling and evaporation is correct?
A
Boiling requires a supply of thermal energy but evaporation does not.
B
Evaporation takes place at the surface of a liquid but boiling takes place throughout the
liquid.
C
When water boils in a kettle, its temperature decreases.
D
When water evaporates, its temperature increases.
